description.value:
You've refined your ability to chain powers together in rapid succession.

When you cast a power that normally has a bonus action casting time, you may instead spend your action to cast a different power whose level is no higher than half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).

Once per long rest, when casting a power with a bonus action casting time, you can cast it without spending force or tech points, provided its level doesn't exceed your proficiency bonus.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
